scope: Original English Pokemon Red/Blue, m01-m10; exclude Yellow/FireRed/LeafGreen

bp2.title: Bulbapedia Red/Blue walkthrough Part 2
bp2.notes: 送包裹获得图鉴后回访Daisy领取地图；常青市有隐藏药水；Route22对手战可选；满足条件后Oak可赠精灵球。

bp3.title: Bulbapedia Red/Blue walkthrough Part 3
bp3.notes: 森林有精灵球一件、解毒药两件、药水两件，包含两件隐藏物；博物馆门票50；古老琥珀需之后有Cut才能取得。

gf-viridian.title: GameFAQs Red Version guide 64175 — Viridian City
gf-viridian.notes: 精灵中心西北灌木旁有可步行绕行的小路，沿路检查树获得隐藏药水；返乡送包裹之后可领取地图。

coordinate_reference.purpose: Only resolve guide landmarks to coordinates and supplement one-time reward contracts; goals originate in online guides.

daisy-town-map-errand.goal: 送包裹前后回访Daisy，取得地图并检查重复与存档恢复
daisy-town-map-errand.setup: fresh m01-m08 via real input, no warp/no starter or flag seeding
daisy-town-map-errand.guide_expectation: 完成Oak包裹后可从Daisy获得Town Map
additional_assertions: 图鉴前没有地图
奖励一次且桌上地图隐藏
重复与保存重启不复制奖励

viridian-hidden-potion-walk.goal: 从常青市南入口绕行灌木小路寻找隐藏药水
viridian-hidden-potion-walk.setup: one warp to city south entrance, seeded Lv5 Bulbasaur; no Cut/Surf
viridian-hidden-potion-walk.guide_expectation: 检查城市西北小路尽头的树获得Potion
additional_assertions: 重复及走回入口保存重启再走回来不复制

forest-five-item-tour.goal: 从森林南入口步行收集五件物品，再从北门离开
forest-five-item-tour.setup: one warp to forest south entrance; Lv20 Bulbasaur combat fixture; no item/flag seeding
forest-five-item-tour.guide_expectation: Poke Ball x1, Antidote x2, Potion x2 including two hidden pickups
additional_assertions: 每次拾取对应背包增加1
重复交互不复制
出北门保存重启后总数不变

route22-rival-oak-balls.goal: 真实主线→训练→Route22可选对手战→回Oak领取5球
route22-rival-oak-balls.setup: fresh m01-m08, real wild training to L13, no warp/item/party/flag seeding
route22-rival-oak-balls.guide_expectation: 击败首次Route22对手且仅初始宝可梦、没有精灵球时，Oak赠5球
additional_assertions: 奖励不重复
保存重启仍有5球
失败保留状态、最多三次真实再战，仍未赢为inconclusive
仅这条支线的玩家策略优先Tackle以避免草系抵抗

forest-natural-encounter-catch.goal: 森林自然遇敌并捕获，验证种类等级与保存恢复
forest-natural-encounter-catch.setup: one warp to south entrance, Lv20 Bulbasaur and 20 balls, no start_wild_battle
additional_assertions: actual encounter species and level preserved on capture
party persists across restart
500 walking segments or 20 exhausted balls => inconclusive, not missing-content failure

forest-pikachu-search-catch.goal: 在森林自然搜索稀有Pikachu并捕获，不通过指定敌人绕过遇敌表
forest-pikachu-search-catch.setup: one entrance warp, Lv20 Bulbasaur and 20 balls; escape other species
forest-pikachu-search-catch.guide_expectation: 森林草地可遇到Lv3或Lv5 Pikachu（攻略列5%）
additional_assertions: 成功捕获且保存恢复
预算耗尽为inconclusive
不将本次样本估算为5%概率的统计验证

museum-reentry-ticket-reset.goal: 参观后出馆再入馆，验证门票按次购买

additional_assertions: 原版PewterCity.asm退出重置票标志
第二次重新支付50元
